comparison: prior production source versus candidate, with same external resource probe; each build also pairs full and complete-required goals

catalog.required_mask: full length, true exactly on missing indices; surviving indices false

scope.counter: caller-thread alloc/alloc_zeroed/realloc request count and full requested size; realloc charged at new size
scope.preparation_windows: prepare_reconstruct_workspace and prepare_reconstruct_some_workspace; owned plan returned before counters stop; destruction outside counter
scope.call_windows: ordinary reconstruct and reconstruct_some on caller-owned ShardSlot backing storage; preparation and execution both inside counter
scope.setup: codec, reference encoding, erasure containers and required flags outside counting; both ordinary APIs warmed before sampling; retained inverse cache shared
scope.coefficients: only data or only parity erasures in resource catalog, avoiding the different composed-parity representation of full versus required mixed goals
scope.oracle: both prepared plans executed outside counting and matched targets; every ordinary and prepared output compared to reference after each call

inherited_execution_control.scope: same production execution sources in prior_commit; complete inherited rows compared without instrumented allocation builds

unchanged_checks: only production recovery_plan.rs and its private test module differ among all 64 src and three build/manifest/lock members
shape creation, complete length scans and reused-layout validation unchanged
decode inverse/cache selection and parity coefficient composition after target selection byte-identical
no execution, encoding, field, matrix, parallel policy or format source changed
all three exact diagnostic generation digests unchanged; actual copies compiled and tested

contracts.complete_requests: target slices borrow the same plan-owned invalid_indices; no borrow of caller required flags
contracts.proper_subsets: first excluded erasure activates owned storage; accepted prefix copied once and suffix filtered in original order; each erasure flag visited once
contracts.coverage: GF8/tower GF16; full/short masks; empty/data/parity/mixed layouts; exclusions at missing-list offsets 0,1,32,64,96; request mutation/drop; existing exhaustive required-mask, singularity, validation and fallible-output tests retained
contracts.baseline_gate: new resource equality gate intentionally fails on prior code after all 72 records; no payload/status assertion fails
contracts.unchanged_resources: all full-recovery control costs unchanged, complete-required costs equal full controls in candidate, <=64 target costs unchanged in both versions

validation.counting: last summary per top-level executable; exclude self-spawned duplicates
validation.observer_exclusions: five resource-counter tests omitted in injected builds; resource data comes from uninstrumented builds; formal sampler catalog unchanged
validation.compatibility: 200 published 9.0.0/current 9.1.0 non-fast exact parity, bidirectional cross-decode and historical tower vectors passed

reproduction.resource: cargo +stable test --release --locked -p rustfs-erasure-codec --features simd-accel --test reconstruct_workspace complete_required_targets -- --nocapture
reproduction.metrics: cargo +stable test --release --locked -p rustfs-erasure-codec --features "simd-accel benchmark-metrics" --test reconstruct_workspace complete_required_targets -- --nocapture
reproduction.baseline: git archive prior_commit into temporary checkout, overlay source_commit tests/reconstruct_workspace.rs verbatim; run same resource and metrics commands; one resource equality gate failure expected after complete rows

remaining_gates: measure real shape/index construction frequency before a broader API or representation change
stable timing environment before arithmetic or parallel threshold tuning; previous ABBA drift failure retained
production verify bottleneck and size/concurrency scratch budget before ordinary verify chunking
production size/thread distribution and process peak budget before Leopard oversized-cache policy change
delivery: implementation and evidence commits only; no push, PR, tag or publication
